title: Harborview approves downtown congestion charge
body: Harborview City Council voted 7-2 on Tuesday to introduce a congestion charge for private cars entering the downtown core on weekdays between 7am and 7pm. Drivers will pay $12 a day, with discounts for residents inside the zone and exemptions for taxis, small delivery vans and disabled badge holders. The council expects the charge to cut peak-hour traffic by 20% and raise $45 million a year, which it says will fund more frequent bus routes and protected bike lanes. The scheme starts next April after a six-month public consultation.
